title: Warm Wholesome Canadian Broccoli Gratin
description: A hearty, comforting broccoli gratin made with purple sprouting broccoli and binchotan charcoal, perfect for a cozy Canadian dinner.
instructions: Rinse the purple sprouting broccoli and trim the ends, then set aside.
In a small saucepan, melt the butter over low heat.
Add the flour and whisk to make a roux, cooking for 1-2 minutes.
Slowly pour in the milk, whisking continuously to avoid lumps.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until it thickens, then set aside.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the broccoli, grated cheese, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Pour the milk mixture over the broccoli and toss to coat.
Transfer the broccoli mixture to a baking dish and sprinkle with binchotan charcoal powder.
Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the broccoli is tender.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 5 minutes before serving.
